subject.title: fix(msteams): read file attachments on Teams channel messages (team GUID + channel fallback + thread-reply URL)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this automatic Microsoft Teams non-personal text/html Graph media fallback, or require a stricter default-off or narrower gate before merging?
rationale: The code fix is focused, but the fallback policy changes Graph call behavior for existing Teams channel/group deployments and could reintroduce mention-only lookup noise if maintainers do not accept the tradeoff.

options.title: Accept the narrowed automatic fallback
options.body: Merge once maintainers accept that non-personal Teams text/html stubs may start best-effort Graph media lookup to recover channel files.

options.title: Require an explicit opt-in gate
options.body: Ask for a default-off Teams option or another owner-approved signal so existing installs do not start extra Graph message lookups automatically.

options.title: Combine with group-chat fallback work
options.body: Pause this PR and ask for one reconciled Teams attachment branch that covers channels, thread replies, group chats, and the mention-only protection together.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrowed automatic fallback
recommendation.body: Merge once maintainers accept that non-personal Teams text/html stubs may start best-effort Graph media lookup to recover channel files.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is currently assigned to steipete and the remaining blocker is a Teams plugin fallback tradeoff rather than a narrow code defect.
